profile.name: 点状选区图形组件
profile.description: 用于科学图像或数据界面中的非物理图形组件，表示一个可编辑的点状选区。它支持边界、中心、尺寸、旋转、区域与掩膜对象生成，以及命中测试、拖拽调整、微调和序列化，常用于显微数据分析中的交互式标注与掩膜定义。
profile.description_en: A non-physical graphical component for scientific image or data interfaces that represents an editable spot-shaped selection. It supports bounds, center, size, rotation, region and mask generation, hit testing, drag adjustment, nudging, and serialization, and is used for interactive annotation and mask definition in microscopy data analysis workflows.
